Set-Content -Path ModManager.cs -Value @"
/*
 * Motor Town Server Mod Manager
 * Built to handle multi-server .pak versioning, smart matching, quick layout deployments, and game launch.
 * Cleaned up and restructured to keep everything maintainable without any auto-generated fluff.
 */

using System;
using System.IO;
using System.IO.Compression;
using System.Drawing;
using System.Windows.Forms;
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;

namespace MotorTownModManager

    public class ModManagerForm : Form
    {
        [DllImport("user32.dll")]
        private static extern bool SetProcessDpiAwarenessContext(int dpiContext);
        private static readonly int DPI_AWARENESS_CONTEXT_PER_MONITOR_AWARE_V2 = -4;

        [DllImport("user32.dll", CharSet = CharSet.Auto)]
        private static extern IntPtr SendMessage(IntPtr hWnd, int msg, IntPtr wParam, IntPtr lParam);
        private const int EM_SETMARGINS = 0xD3;
        private const int EC_LEFTMARGIN = 0x1;

        // Fix: when ModManager.exe is run elevated ("Run as administrator") - which many
        // users do because the default paks path is under Program Files (x86) - Windows'
        // User Interface Privilege Isolation (UIPI) silently blocks drag-and-drop coming
        // from a non-elevated Explorer window. No exception is thrown; the drop is just
        // swallowed. ChangeWindowMessageFilterEx explicitly allows the messages that
        // drag-and-drop relies on through that isolation boundary.
        [DllImport("user32.dll")]
        private static extern bool ChangeWindowMessageFilterEx(IntPtr hWnd, uint message, uint action, IntPtr changeInfo);
        private const uint MSGFLT_ALLOW = 1;
        private const uint WM_DROPFILES = 0x0233;
        private const uint WM_COPYDATA = 0x004A;
        private const uint WM_COPYGLOBALDATA = 0x0049;
        private const int WM_SETREDRAW = 0x000B;

        // Applies Windows' built-in "DarkMode_Explorer" visual style to a control's native
        // scrollbar (Explorer, File Manager, etc. all use this same mechanism for themed
        // scrollbars) - this is what actually recolors the ListBox's scrollbar thumb/track,
        // since there's no public WinForms property for that.
        [DllImport("uxtheme.dll", CharSet = CharSet.Unicode)]
        private static extern int SetWindowTheme(IntPtr hWnd, string pszSubAppName, string pszSubIdList);

        // Lets the window's own title bar (where the minimize/maximize/X buttons live) match
        // the app's theme. DWMWA_CAPTION_COLOR/DWMWA_TEXT_COLOR (Windows 11 22000+) allow a
        // fully custom color; DWMWA_USE_IMMERSIVE_DARK_MODE is the older dark/light-only
        // fallback for Windows 10. Both are best-effort - older systems simply keep the
        // default title bar if neither call is supported.
        [DllImport("dwmapi.dll")]
        private static extern int DwmSetWindowAttribute(IntPtr hwnd, int attr, ref int attrValue, int attrSize);
        private const int DWMWA_USE_IMMERSIVE_DARK_MODE = 20;
        private const int DWMWA_CAPTION_COLOR = 35;
        private const int DWMWA_TEXT_COLOR = 36;

        // Fix: reading virtual "FileContents" (dragging files out of an open Zip/Explorer
        // preview window) with no index always returns the FIRST file's bytes for every
        // entry, so a multi-file virtual drop silently duplicates one file's content under
        // every dropped name. These P/Invokes let us pull each file's content by its own
        // index instead.
        [DllImport("ole32.dll")]
        private static extern void ReleaseStgMedium(ref System.Runtime.InteropServices.ComTypes.STGMEDIUM medium);
        [DllImport("kernel32.dll")]
        private static extern IntPtr GlobalLock(IntPtr hMem);
        [DllImport("kernel32.dll")]
        private static extern bool GlobalUnlock(IntPtr hMem);
        [DllImport("kernel32.dll")]
        private static extern int GlobalSize(IntPtr hMem);

        // Fix: names coming from FILEDESCRIPTORW (virtual drag-drop) are attacker-influenced
        // data, not real filesystem paths. Path.Combine will happily honor "..\..\evil.exe"
        // or an absolute path like "C:\Windows\..." and write outside the intended folder.
        // This strips any directory component and re-validates the final path stays inside
        // destDir before anything is written to disk.
        // Fix (Zip Slip): ZipFile.ExtractToDirectory on .NET Framework does not validate
        // that entry paths stay inside the destination folder. A crafted .pak/.zip with an
        // entry named e.g. "..\..\..\AppData\Roaming\Startup\evil.exe" would otherwise be
        // written outside destDir. This extracts entry-by-entry and rejects any entry whose
        // resolved path would escape destDir.
        private static void SafeExtractZip(string zipPath, string destDir)
        {
            Directory.CreateDirectory(destDir);
            string destFull = Path.GetFullPath(destDir);
            if (!destFull.EndsWith(Path.DirectorySeparatorChar.ToString()))
                destFull += Path.DirectorySeparatorChar;

            using (ZipArchive archive = ZipFile.OpenRead(zipPath))
            {
                foreach (ZipArchiveEntry entry in archive.Entries)
                {
                    string entryName = entry.FullName.Replace('/', Path.DirectorySeparatorChar);

                    if (Path.IsPathRooted(entryName) || entryName.Contains(".."))
                    {
                        continue; // reject suspicious entry outright
                    }

                    string targetPath = Path.GetFullPath(Path.Combine(destFull, entryName));
                    if (!targetPath.StartsWith(destFull, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    {
                        continue; // resolved path still escaped destDir - extra safety net
                    }

                    if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(entry.Name))
                    {
                        // directory entry
                        Directory.CreateDirectory(targetPath);
                        continue;
                    }

                    string parentDir = Path.GetDirectoryName(targetPath);
                    if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(parentDir))
                    {
                        Directory.CreateDirectory(parentDir);
                    }

                    entry.ExtractToFile(targetPath, true);
                }
            }
        }

        private static string SafeCombineWithinDirectory(string destDir, string untrustedName)
        {
            string bareName = Path.GetFileName(untrustedName);
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(bareName)) return null;

            string destFull = Path.GetFullPath(destDir);
            if (!destFull.EndsWith(Path.DirectorySeparatorChar.ToString()))
                destFull += Path.DirectorySeparatorChar;

            string candidate = Path.GetFullPath(Path.Combine(destFull, bareName));
            if (!candidate.StartsWith(destFull, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                return null;

            return candidate;
        }

        private static byte[] GetVirtualFileContents(object dataObject, int index)
        {
            System.Runtime.InteropServices.ComTypes.IDataObject comData = dataObject as System.Runtime.InteropServices.ComTypes.IDataObject;
            if (comData == null) return null;

            System.Runtime.InteropServices.ComTypes.FORMATETC formatEtc = new System.Runtime.InteropServices.ComTypes.FORMATETC
            {
                cfFormat = (short)DataFormats.GetFormat("FileContents").Id,
                ptd = IntPtr.Zero,
                dwAspect = System.Runtime.InteropServices.ComTypes.DVASPECT.DVASPECT_CONTENT,
                lindex = index,
                tymed = System.Runtime.InteropServices.ComTypes.TYMED.TYMED_ISTREAM | System.Runtime.InteropServices.ComTypes.TYMED.TYMED_HGLOBAL
            };

            System.Runtime.InteropServices.ComTypes.STGMEDIUM medium;
            try
            {
                comData.GetData(ref formatEtc, out medium);
            }
            catch
            {
                return null;
            }

            try
            {
                if (medium.tymed == System.Runtime.InteropServices.ComTypes.TYMED.TYMED_ISTREAM)
                {
                    System.Runtime.InteropServices.ComTypes.IStream nativeStream =
                        (System.Runtime.InteropServices.ComTypes.IStream)Marshal.GetObjectForIUnknown(medium.unionmember);

                    System.Runtime.InteropServices.ComTypes.STATSTG stat;
                    nativeStream.Stat(out stat, 0);
                    int size = (int)stat.cbSize;

                    byte[] buffer = new byte[size];
                    nativeStream.Read(buffer, size, IntPtr.Zero);
                    return buffer;
                }
                else if (medium.tymed == System.Runtime.InteropServices.ComTypes.TYMED.TYMED_HGLOBAL)
                {
                    IntPtr ptr = GlobalLock(medium.unionmember);
                    if (ptr == IntPtr.Zero) return null;
                    try
                    {
                        int size = GlobalSize(medium.unionmember);
                        byte[] buffer = new byte[size];
                        Marshal.Copy(ptr, buffer, 0, size);
                        return buffer;
                    }
                    finally
                    {
                        GlobalUnlock(medium.unionmember);
                    }
                }
            }
            finally
            {
                ReleaseStgMedium(ref medium);
            }

            return null;
        }

        private const string DefaultGamePath = @"C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Motor Town\MotorTown\Content\Paks";
        private const string ConfigFileName = "config.json";

        [STAThread]
        public static void Main()
        {
            try
            {
                try { SetProcessDpiAwarenessContext(DPI_AWARENESS_CONTEXT_PER_MONITOR_AWARE_V2); } catch { }

                Application.EnableVisualStyles();
                Application.SetCompatibleTextRenderingDefault(false);
                Application.Run(new ModManagerForm());
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                MessageBox.Show("Fatal Startup Error: " + ex.ToString(), "Launch Failed", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);
            }
        }

        public ModManagerForm()
        {
            SetStyle(ControlStyles.AllPaintingInWmPaint | ControlStyles.UserPaint | ControlStyles.OptimizedDoubleBuffer, true);

            Text = "MotorTown: Behind The Wheel - Mod Manager";
            Width = 560;
            Height = 1170;
            MinimumSize = new Size(560, 1170);

            FormBorderStyle = FormBorderStyle.Sizable;
            MaximizeBox = true;
            StartPosition = FormStartPosition.CenterScreen;

            backupStorageDir = Path.Combine(serverStorageDir, "Backup_Vanilla");
            saveGameBackupDir = Path.Combine(serverStorageDir, "Backup_Saves");
            settingsFilePath = Path.Combine(serverStorageDir, "settings.txt");

            EnsureStorageDirectoryExists();
            InitializeComponentLayout();

            WrapControlWithLightModeBorder(cboThemeSelector);
            WrapControlWithLightModeBorder(txtServerSearchBox);
            WrapControlWithLightModeBorder(cboServerDropdown);
            WrapControlWithLightModeBorder(txtModSearchBox);
            WrapControlWithLightModeBorder(cboEditorSelector);

            BuildDragOverlay();
            BuildBusyOverlay();
            SetupListResizeSplitter();

            dragLeaveTimer.Tick += delegate { dragLeaveTimer.Stop(); HideDragOverlay(); };

            // Make the whole window (not just the drop panel) a drag-and-drop target, so
            // dragging a file anywhere over the app - not just the little panel - triggers
            // the full-screen overlay and accepts the drop.
            EnableDragDropRecursive(this);
            
            LoadCheckboxSettings();

            if (cboThemeSelector.SelectedIndex == -1)
            {
                cboThemeSelector.SelectedIndex = 0; 
            }
            if (cboEditorSelector.SelectedIndex == -1)
            {
                cboEditorSelector.SelectedIndex = 0;
            }

            LoadInitialPath();
            RefreshServerList();
        }

        private void EnableDragDropRecursive(Control parent)
        {
            parent.AllowDrop = true;
            parent.DragEnter += OnPanelDragEnter;
            parent.DragLeave += AnyControl_DragLeave;
            parent.DragDrop += OnPanelDragDrop;

            foreach (Control child in parent.Controls)
            {
                EnableDragDropRecursive(child);
            }
        }

        private void BuildDragOverlay()
        {
            pnlDragOverlay = new DoubleBufferedPanel
            {
                Dock = DockStyle.Fill,
                BackColor = Color.FromArgb(20, 20, 24),
                Visible = false
            };

            Label lblOverlayText = new Label
            {
                Text = "Drop .pak, .zip or ReadMe Files Here",
                Font = new Font(FontFamily.GenericSansSerif, 18, FontStyle.Bold),
                ForeColor = Color.White,
                Dock = DockStyle.Fill,
                TextAlign = ContentAlignment.MiddleCenter
            };

            pnlDragOverlay.Paint += delegate(object s, PaintEventArgs pe)
            {
                pe.Graphics.SmoothingMode = System.Drawing.Drawing2D.SmoothingMode.AntiAlias;
                int margin = 22;
                Rectangle borderRect = new Rectangle(margin, margin, pnlDragOverlay.Width - (margin * 2), pnlDragOverlay.Height - (margin * 2));
                using (Pen whitePen = new Pen(Color.White, 4f) { DashStyle = System.Drawing.Drawing2D.DashStyle.Dash })
                {
                    pe.Graphics.DrawRectangle(whitePen, borderRect);
                }
            };

            pnlDragOverlay.Controls.Add(lblOverlayText);
            Controls.Add(pnlDragOverlay);
            pnlDragOverlay.BringToFront();
        }

        private void BuildBusyOverlay()
        {
            pnlBusyOverlay = new DoubleBufferedPanel { Dock = DockStyle.Fill, Visible = false };

            pnlBusyOverlay.Paint += delegate(object s, PaintEventArgs pe)
            {
                bool isLight = IsLightTheme();
                pe.Graphics.Clear(isLight ? Color.FromArgb(235, 250, 250, 250) : Color.FromArgb(235, 20, 20, 24));
                pe.Graphics.SmoothingMode = System.Drawing.Drawing2D.SmoothingMode.AntiAlias;

                int size = 48;
                Rectangle spinnerRect = new Rectangle(pnlBusyOverlay.Width / 2 - size / 2, pnlBusyOverlay.Height / 2 - size / 2 - 16, size, size);
                Color spinnerColor = isLight ? Color.FromArgb(70, 70, 70) : Color.White;
                using (Pen spinnerPen = new Pen(spinnerColor, 4.5f) { StartCap = System.Drawing.Drawing2D.LineCap.Round, EndCap = System.Drawing.Drawing2D.LineCap.Round })
                {
                    pe.Graphics.DrawArc(spinnerPen, spinnerRect, busySpinnerAngle, 270);
                }

                Rectangle textRect = new Rectangle(0, spinnerRect.Bottom + 14, pnlBusyOverlay.Width, 30);
                Color textColor = isLight ? Color.FromArgb(40, 40, 40) : TextLight;
                using (Font statusFont = new Font(FontFamily.GenericSansSerif, 10, FontStyle.Bold))
                {
                    TextRenderer.DrawText(pe.Graphics, busyStatusText, statusFont, textRect, textColor, TextFormatFlags.HorizontalCenter);
                }
            };

            busySpinnerTimer.Tick += delegate
            {
                busySpinnerAngle = (busySpinnerAngle + 18f) % 360f;
                if (pnlBusyOverlay.Visible) pnlBusyOverlay.Invalidate();
            };

            Controls.Add(pnlBusyOverlay);
        }

        // Shows a full-window, theme-aware spinner that blocks interaction with the rest of
        // the app (it simply covers everything, on top) without freezing the window itself -
        // the actual work is expected to run on a background thread via Task.Run while this
        // is visible, so the UI stays responsive and repaints normally.
        private void ShowBusyOverlay(string statusText)
        {
            busyStatusText = statusText;
            pnlBusyOverlay.Visible = true;
            pnlBusyOverlay.BringToFront();
            busySpinnerTimer.Start();
        }

        private void HideBusyOverlay()
        {
            busySpinnerTimer.Stop();
            pnlBusyOverlay.Visible = false;
        }

        private void SetupListResizeSplitter()
        {
            const int MinListHeight = 60;
            const int MaxListHeight = 400;

            pnlListSplitter = new DoubleBufferedPanel
            {
                Location = new Point(lstServerPaks.Left, lstServerPaks.Bottom + 1),
                Width = lstServerPaks.Width,
                Height = 10,
                Cursor = Cursors.SizeNS,
                Anchor = AnchorStyles.Top | AnchorStyles.Left | AnchorStyles.Right
            };

            pnlListSplitter.Paint += delegate(object s, PaintEventArgs pe)
            {
                bool isLight = IsLightTheme();
                int midY = pnlListSplitter.Height / 2;
                int centerX = pnlListSplitter.Width / 2;
                using (Pen gripPen = new Pen(isLight ? Color.Gray : TextMuted, 2f))
                {
                    pe.Graphics.DrawLine(gripPen, centerX - 18, midY, centerX + 18, midY);
                }
            };

            // Remember every control that currently sits below the list, as an offset from
            // the list's bottom edge, so they can all be shifted down/up together whenever
            // the list is resized - otherwise resizing the list would make it overlap the
            // buttons below it instead of pushing them out of the way. Everything in this
            // set was switched to Top-only anchoring (see InitializeComponentLayout) so
            // WinForms' own anchor engine never fights with this manual repositioning - that
            // fight is what caused the splitter to "disconnect" whenever the window itself
            // was resized.
            listSplitterControlOffsets = new Dictionary<Control, int>();
            int listBottom = lstServerPaks.Bottom;
            foreach (Control ctrl in Controls)
            {
                if (ctrl != lstServerPaks && ctrl.Top >= listBottom)
                {
                    listSplitterControlOffsets[ctrl] = ctrl.Top - listBottom;
                }
            }

            int dragStartMouseY = 0;
            int dragStartListHeight = 0;
            bool isDraggingSplitter = false;

            pnlListSplitter.MouseDown += delegate(object s, MouseEventArgs e)
            {
                dragStartMouseY = Cursor.Position.Y;
                dragStartListHeight = lstServerPaks.Height;
                isDraggingSplitter = true;
            };

            pnlListSplitter.MouseMove += delegate(object s, MouseEventArgs e)
            {
                if (!isDraggingSplitter || e.Button != MouseButtons.Left) return;

                int desiredHeight = dragStartListHeight + (Cursor.Position.Y - dragStartMouseY);
                desiredHeight = Math.Max(MinListHeight, Math.Min(MaxListHeight, desiredHeight));

                int heightDelta = desiredHeight - lstServerPaks.Height;
                if (heightDelta == 0) return;

                // SuspendLayout only batches layout MATH (anchor/dock recalculation) - it does
                // NOT stop the OS from repainting each moved child window as it's moved. With
                // ~20 controls being repositioned on every mouse-move tick, that produced the
                // "hundreds of buttons" ghosting glitch. WM_SETREDRAW actually suspends
                // painting at the window level, so nothing is drawn until the single Update()
                // call at the end - eliminating the ghosting at its real cause.
                SendMessage(Handle, WM_SETREDRAW, (IntPtr)0, IntPtr.Zero);
                SuspendLayout();

                lstServerPaks.Height = desiredHeight;
                RepositionControlsBelowList();

                // Resized live (not deferred to mouse-up) so the window never clips content
                // while dragging down, and dragging back up shrinks it smoothly in real time
                // instead of leaving it the wrong size afterward. Order matters: shrink the
                // floor before the window when getting smaller, and grow the window before
                // the floor when getting bigger, or WinForms clamps the Height change against
                // a stale MinimumSize.
                int newMinHeight = MinimumSize.Height + heightDelta;
                if (heightDelta < 0)
                {
                    MinimumSize = new Size(MinimumSize.Width, newMinHeight);
                    Height += heightDelta;
                }
                else
                {
                    Height += heightDelta;
                    MinimumSize = new Size(MinimumSize.Width, newMinHeight);
                }

                ResumeLayout(false);
                SendMessage(Handle, WM_SETREDRAW, (IntPtr)1, IntPtr.Zero);
                Invalidate(true);
                Update();
            };

            pnlListSplitter.MouseUp += delegate(object s, MouseEventArgs e)
            {
                isDraggingSplitter = false;
            };

            Controls.Add(pnlListSplitter);
            pnlListSplitter.BringToFront();
        }

        private void RepositionControlsBelowList()
        {
            pnlListSplitter.Top = lstServerPaks.Bottom + 1;

            int newListBottom = lstServerPaks.Bottom;
            foreach (KeyValuePair<Control, int> kvp in listSplitterControlOffsets)
            {
                kvp.Key.Top = newListBottom + kvp.Value;
            }
        }

        protected override void OnHandleCreated(EventArgs e)
        {
            base.OnHandleCreated(e);

            // Allow drag-and-drop messages through even if this process is running elevated.
            try
            {
                ChangeWindowMessageFilterEx(Handle, WM_DROPFILES, MSGFLT_ALLOW, IntPtr.Zero);
                ChangeWindowMessageFilterEx(Handle, WM_COPYDATA, MSGFLT_ALLOW, IntPtr.Zero);
                ChangeWindowMessageFilterEx(Handle, WM_COPYGLOBALDATA, MSGFLT_ALLOW, IntPtr.Zero);
            }
            catch { }
        }

        private string GetEffectiveEngineIniPath()
        {
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(customEngineIniPath) && File.Exists(customEngineIniPath))
            {
                return customEngineIniPath;
            }

            string defaultPath = Path.Combine(Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.LocalApplicationData), @"MotorTown\Saved\Config\Windows\Engine.ini");
            if (File.Exists(defaultPath))
            {
                return defaultPath;
            }

            return defaultPath;
        }

        private bool EnsureEngineIniExists(out string targetPath)
        {
            targetPath = GetEffectiveEngineIniPath();

            if (File.Exists(targetPath))
            {
                return true;
            }

            DialogResult result = MessageBox.Show(
                "Could not locate 'Engine.ini' automatically.\n\nWould you like to browse and locate your 'Engine.ini' file manually?",
                "Engine.ini Not Found",
                MessageBoxButtons.YesNo,
                MessageBoxIcon.Warning);

            if (result == DialogResult.Yes)
            {
                using (OpenFileDialog ofd = new OpenFileDialog())
                {
                    ofd.Title = "Select Engine.ini File";
                    ofd.Filter = "INI Configuration Files (*.ini)|*.ini|All Files (*.*)|*.*";
                    ofd.FileName = "Engine.ini";

                    if (ofd.ShowDialog(this) == DialogResult.OK)
                    {
                        customEngineIniPath = ofd.FileName;
                        SaveCheckboxSettings();
                        targetPath = customEngineIniPath;
                        return true;
                    }
                }
            }

            return false;
        }

        private void EnsureStorageDirectoryExists()
        {
            try
            {
                if (!Directory.Exists(serverStorageDir))
                    Directory.CreateDirectory(serverStorageDir);
                if (!Directory.Exists(backupStorageDir))
                    Directory.CreateDirectory(backupStorageDir);
                if (!Directory.Exists(saveGameBackupDir))
                    Directory.CreateDirectory(saveGameBackupDir);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                ShowError("Initializing Storage Directory", ex);
            }
        }

        private void LoadCheckboxSettings()
        {
            try
            {
                if (File.Exists(settingsFilePath))
                {
                    string[] lines = File.ReadAllLines(settingsFilePath);
                    foreach (string line in lines)
                    {
                        if (line.StartsWith("SmartMatching=", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        {
                            bool val;
                            if (bool.TryParse(line.Substring(13).Trim(), out val))
                                chkSmartMatching.Checked = val;
                        }
                        else if (line.StartsWith("AutoEngineIni=", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        {
                            bool val;
                            if (bool.TryParse(line.Substring(14).Trim(), out val))
                                chkAutoEngineIni.Checked = val;
                        }
                        else if (line.StartsWith("Theme=", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        {
                            string theme = line.Substring(6).Trim();
                            for (int i = 0; i < cboThemeSelector.Items.Count; i++)
                            {
                                if (cboThemeSelector.Items[i].ToString().Equals(theme, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                                {
                                    cboThemeSelector.SelectedIndex = i;
                                    break;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        else if (line.StartsWith("PreferredEditor=", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        {
                            string editor = line.Substring(16).Trim();
                            for (int i = 0; i < cboEditorSelector.Items.Count; i++)
                            {
                                if (cboEditorSelector.Items[i].ToString().Equals(editor, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                                {
                                    cboEditorSelector.SelectedIndex = i;
                                    break;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        else if (line.StartsWith("EngineIniPath=", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        {
                            string path = line.Substring(14).Trim();
                            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(path))
                            {
                                customEngineIniPath = path;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            catch { }
        }

        private void SaveCheckboxSettings()
        {
            try
            {
                string themeName = (cboThemeSelector.SelectedItem != null) ? cboThemeSelector.SelectedItem.ToString() : "Dark Mode";
                string editorName = (cboEditorSelector.SelectedItem != null) ? cboEditorSelector.SelectedItem.ToString() : "Windows Notepad";
                string iniPathEntry = !string.IsNullOrEmpty(customEngineIniPath) ? customEngineIniPath : "";
                
                string content = "SmartMatching=" + chkSmartMatching.Checked.ToString() + "\n" +
                                 "AutoEngineIni=" + chkAutoEngineIni.Checked.ToString() + "\n" +
                                 "Theme=" + themeName + "\n" +
                                 "PreferredEditor=" + editorName + "\n" +
                                 "EngineIniPath=" + iniPathEntry + "\n";
                File.WriteAllText(settingsFilePath, content);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                ShowError("Saving Checkbox Settings", ex);
            }
        }

        private void UpdateOpenEngineIniButtonText()
        {
            string editor = (cboEditorSelector.SelectedItem != null) ? cboEditorSelector.SelectedItem.ToString() : "Windows Notepad";
            btnOpenEngineIni.Text = "Open Engine.ini in " + editor;
        }

        private void AttachSearchIcon(TextBox textBox)
        {
            PictureBox iconBox = new PictureBox
            {
                Size = new Size(16, 16),
                Location = new Point(3, 2),
                Cursor = Cursors.IBeam,
                BackColor = Color.Transparent
            };

            iconBox.Paint += delegate(object s, PaintEventArgs pe)
            {
                pe.Graphics.SmoothingMode = System.Drawing.Drawing2D.SmoothingMode.AntiAlias;
                Color color = (cboThemeSelector.SelectedItem != null && cboThemeSelector.SelectedItem.ToString() == "Light Mode") 
                    ? Color.Gray 
                    : AccentOrange;

                using (Pen pen = new Pen(color, 1.8f))
                {
                    pe.Graphics.DrawEllipse(pen, 1, 1, 8, 8);
                    pe.Graphics.DrawLine(pen, 8, 8, 13, 13);
                }
            };

            iconBox.Click += delegate(object s, EventArgs e) { textBox.Focus(); };

            Panel paddingPanel = new Panel
            {
                Size = new Size(20, textBox.ClientSize.Height),
                Dock = DockStyle.Left,
                BackColor = Color.Transparent
            };
            paddingPanel.Controls.Add(iconBox);
            textBox.Controls.Add(paddingPanel);

            SendMessage(textBox.Handle, EM_SETMARGINS, (IntPtr)EC_LEFTMARGIN, (IntPtr)(20 & 0xFFFF));
        }

        private class ThemeColors
        {
            public Color WindowBg;
            public Color ControlBg;
            public Color TextColor;
            public Color HeaderColor;
            public Color ButtonBg;
            public Color ButtonFg;
            public Color AccentColor;
            public bool IsLightBase;
            public bool UseBlackBorder;
            public bool UseDarkScrollbar;
            public bool DarkTitleBar;
            public Color TitleBarColor;
            public Color TitleBarTextColor;
        }

        private string CurrentThemeName()
        {
            return cboThemeSelector.SelectedItem != null ? cboThemeSelector.SelectedItem.ToString() : "Dark Mode";
        }

        private ThemeColors GetThemeColors(string themeName)
        {
            switch (themeName)
            {
                case "Light Mode":
                    return new ThemeColors
                    {
                        WindowBg = SystemColors.Control,
                        ControlBg = SystemColors.Window,
                        TextColor = SystemColors.WindowText,
                        HeaderColor = SystemColors.ControlText,
                        ButtonBg = SystemColors.ControlLight,
                        ButtonFg = SystemColors.ControlText,
                        AccentColor = SystemColors.ControlLight,
                        IsLightBase = true,
                        UseBlackBorder = true,
                        UseDarkScrollbar = false,
                        DarkTitleBar = false,
                        TitleBarColor = SystemColors.Control,
                        TitleBarTextColor = SystemColors.ControlText
                    };
                case "Cerulean Blue":
                    return new ThemeColors
                    {
                        WindowBg = Color.FromArgb(16, 40, 61),
                        ControlBg = Color.FromArgb(24, 56, 82),
                        TextColor = Color.FromArgb(228, 242, 250),
                        HeaderColor = Color.FromArgb(120, 202, 255),
                        ButtonBg = Color.FromArgb(24, 56, 82),
                        ButtonFg = Color.FromArgb(228, 242, 250),
                        AccentColor = Color.FromArgb(0, 149, 217),
                        IsLightBase = false,
                        UseBlackBorder = false,
                        UseDarkScrollbar = true,
                        DarkTitleBar = true,
                        TitleBarColor = Color.FromArgb(16, 40, 61),
                        TitleBarTextColor = Color.FromArgb(228, 242, 250)
                    };
                case "Amethyst Purple":
                    return new ThemeColors
                    {
                        WindowBg = Color.FromArgb(36, 22, 54),
                        ControlBg = Color.FromArgb(52, 34, 76),
                        TextColor = Color.FromArgb(238, 228, 248),
                        HeaderColor = Color.FromArgb(198, 155, 240),
                        ButtonBg = Color.FromArgb(52, 34, 76),
                        ButtonFg = Color.FromArgb(238, 228, 248),
                        AccentColor = Color.FromArgb(153, 102, 204),
                        IsLightBase = false,
                        UseBlackBorder = false,
                        UseDarkScrollbar = true,
                        DarkTitleBar = true,
                        TitleBarColor = Color.FromArgb(36, 22, 54),
                        TitleBarTextColor = Color.FromArgb(238, 228, 248)
                    };
                default: // "Dark Mode"
                    return new ThemeColors
                    {
                        WindowBg = ThemeDarkBg,
                        ControlBg = ThemeControlDark,
                        TextColor = TextLight,
                        HeaderColor = AccentYellow,
                        ButtonBg = ThemeControlDark,
                        ButtonFg = TextLight,
                        AccentColor = AccentOrange,
                        IsLightBase = false,
                        UseBlackBorder = false,
                        UseDarkScrollbar = true,
                        DarkTitleBar = true,
                        TitleBarColor = ThemeDarkBg,
                        TitleBarTextColor = TextLight
                    };
            }
        }

        private bool IsLightTheme()
        {
            return CurrentThemeName() == "Light Mode";
        }

        // ComboBox and TextBox don't expose a reliable way to force a specific border color -
        // their default border can look nearly invisible against a light background. This
        // draws a crisp black frame using a SEPARATE sibling panel positioned just outside the
        // control's existing bounds - deliberately NOT by reparenting/docking the control
        // itself into a container, since doing that to an edit control can silently break its
        // own text/caret rendering (exactly what happened to the mod search box previously).
        // The original control is never touched: same parent, same position, same everything.
        private void WrapControlWithLightModeBorder(Control inner)
        {
            Panel borderPanel = new DoubleBufferedPanel
            {
                Location = new Point(inner.Left - 1, inner.Top - 1),
                Size = new Size(inner.Width + 2, inner.Height + 2),
                Anchor = inner.Anchor
            };

            borderPanel.Paint += delegate(object s, PaintEventArgs pe)
            {
                if (IsLightTheme())
                {
                    using (Pen borderPen = new Pen(Color.Black, 1f))
                    {
                        pe.Graphics.DrawRectangle(borderPen, 0, 0, borderPanel.Width - 1, borderPanel.Height - 1);
                    }
                }
            };

            inner.Parent.Controls.Add(borderPanel);
        }

        // Setting ComboBox.BackColor/ForeColor alone only reliably recolors the closed box -
        // the open dropdown list often still renders with the system's default white
        // background on Windows regardless of those properties. Owner-drawing every item
        // guarantees the dropdown itself matches the current theme too.
        private void ThemedComboBox_DrawItem(object sender, DrawItemEventArgs e)
        {
            ComboBox combo = sender as ComboBox;
            if (combo == null || e.Index < 0) return;

            ThemeColors t = GetThemeColors(CurrentThemeName());
            bool isSelected = (e.State & DrawItemState.Selected) == DrawItemState.Selected;

            Color backColor = isSelected
                ? (t.IsLightBase ? SystemColors.Highlight : t.AccentColor)
                : (t.IsLightBase ? SystemColors.Window : t.ControlBg);
            Color foreColor = isSelected
                ? (t.IsLightBase ? SystemColors.HighlightText : Color.Black)
                : (t.IsLightBase ? SystemColors.WindowText : t.TextColor);

            using (SolidBrush backBrush = new SolidBrush(backColor))
            {
                e.Graphics.FillRectangle(backBrush, e.Bounds);
            }

            string text = combo.Items[e.Index].ToString();
            TextRenderer.DrawText(e.Graphics, text, combo.Font, e.Bounds, foreColor, TextFormatFlags.VerticalCenter | TextFormatFlags.Left);
        }

        // Recolors an entire dialog (and every control on it) to match whichever theme is
        // currently selected in the main window, instead of the default light/white system
        // colors WinForms dialogs get otherwise. Call this once, after all of a dialog's
        // controls have been added, right before ShowDialog().
        private void ApplyDialogTheme(Form dlg)
        {
            ThemeColors t = GetThemeColors(CurrentThemeName());

            dlg.BackColor = t.WindowBg;
            dlg.ForeColor = t.TextColor;

            ApplyDialogThemeToControls(dlg.Controls, t);

            try
            {
                int useDark = t.DarkTitleBar ? 1 : 0;
                DwmSetWindowAttribute(dlg.Handle, DWMWA_USE_IMMERSIVE_DARK_MODE, ref useDark, sizeof(int));
                int captionColorRef = ColorToColorRef(t.TitleBarColor);
                DwmSetWindowAttribute(dlg.Handle, DWMWA_CAPTION_COLOR, ref captionColorRef, sizeof(int));
                int textColorRef = ColorToColorRef(t.TitleBarTextColor);
                DwmSetWindowAttribute(dlg.Handle, DWMWA_TEXT_COLOR, ref textColorRef, sizeof(int));
            }
            catch { }
        }

        private void ApplyDialogThemeToControls(Control.ControlCollection controls, ThemeColors t)
        {
            foreach (Control child in controls)
            {
                if (child is ShinyButton || child is Button)
                {
                    child.BackColor = t.ButtonBg;
                    child.ForeColor = t.ButtonFg;
                }
                else if (child is TextBox || child is ComboBox || child is ListBox || child is CheckedListBox)
                {
                    child.BackColor = t.ControlBg;
                    child.ForeColor = t.TextColor;
                }
                else if (child is Label || child is CheckBox || child is RadioButton)
                {
                    child.ForeColor = t.TextColor;
                    child.BackColor = Color.Transparent;
                }
                else if (child is Panel || child is GroupBox || child is TableLayoutPanel || child is FlowLayoutPanel)
                {
                    child.BackColor = t.WindowBg;
                }

                if (child.Controls.Count > 0)
                {
                    ApplyDialogThemeToControls(child.Controls, t);
                }
            }
        }

        private void ApplyTheme(string themeName)
        {
            ThemeColors t = GetThemeColors(themeName);
            bool isDarkModeSpecifically = (themeName == "Dark Mode");

            BackgroundImage = null;
            BackColor = t.WindowBg;

            lblPathHeader.ForeColor = t.HeaderColor;
            lblServerHeader.ForeColor = t.HeaderColor;
            lblThemeHeader.ForeColor = t.HeaderColor;
            lblModSearchHeader.ForeColor = t.HeaderColor;
            lblEditorHeader.ForeColor = t.HeaderColor;
            lblPathHeader.BackColor = Color.Transparent;
            lblServerHeader.BackColor = Color.Transparent;
            lblThemeHeader.BackColor = Color.Transparent;
            lblModSearchHeader.BackColor = Color.Transparent;
            lblEditorHeader.BackColor = Color.Transparent;

            foreach (var ctrl in new Control[] { txtGamePath, txtServerSearchBox, cboServerDropdown, cboThemeSelector, cboEditorSelector, txtModSearchBox, lstServerPaks })
            {
                ctrl.BackColor = t.ControlBg;
                ctrl.ForeColor = t.TextColor;
            }

            foreach (var btn in new Button[] { btnBrowsePath, btnOpenDirectory, btnBackupPaks, btnRestoreBackup, btnBackupSaves, btnManageSaves })
            {
                btn.BackColor = t.ButtonBg;
                btn.ForeColor = t.ButtonFg;
                btn.FlatStyle = t.IsLightBase ? FlatStyle.Standard : FlatStyle.Flat;
            }

            // "Green like Launch Game, but only in Dark Mode" - normal theme-matching color
            // everywhere else (Light Mode, and the new Cerulean/Amethyst themes).
            Color addMergeColor = isDarkModeSpecifically ? Color.FromArgb(40, 140, 60) : t.ButtonBg;
            btnAddServerFolder.BackColor = addMergeColor;
            btnAddServerFolder.ForeColor = t.ButtonFg;
            btnAddServerFolder.FlatStyle = t.IsLightBase ? FlatStyle.Standard : FlatStyle.Flat;

            btnMergeServerMods.BackColor = addMergeColor;
            btnMergeServerMods.ForeColor = t.ButtonFg;
            btnMergeServerMods.FlatStyle = t.IsLightBase ? FlatStyle.Standard : FlatStyle.Flat;

            btnDeleteServerFolder.BackColor = t.IsLightBase ? SystemColors.ControlLight : Color.FromArgb(160, 35, 35);
            btnDeleteServerFolder.ForeColor = t.ButtonFg;
            btnDeleteServerFolder.FlatStyle = t.IsLightBase ? FlatStyle.Standard : FlatStyle.Flat;

            btnDeleteSelectedPak.BackColor = t.IsLightBase ? SystemColors.ControlLight : Color.FromArgb(160, 35, 35);
            btnDeleteSelectedPak.ForeColor = t.ButtonFg;
            btnDeleteSelectedPak.FlatStyle = t.IsLightBase ? FlatStyle.Standard : FlatStyle.Flat;

            btnDeployMods.BackColor = t.IsLightBase ? SystemColors.ControlLight : t.AccentColor;
            btnDeployMods.ForeColor = t.IsLightBase ? SystemColors.ControlText : Color.Black;
            btnDeployMods.FlatStyle = t.IsLightBase ? FlatStyle.Standard : FlatStyle.Flat;

            btnRevertVanilla.BackColor = t.IsLightBase ? SystemColors.ControlLight : Color.FromArgb(180, 80, 20);
            btnRevertVanilla.ForeColor = t.ButtonFg;
            btnRevertVanilla.FlatStyle = t.IsLightBase ? FlatStyle.Standard : FlatStyle.Flat;

            btnOpenEngineIni.BackColor = t.ButtonBg;
            btnOpenEngineIni.ForeColor = t.ButtonFg;
            btnOpenEngineIni.FlatStyle = t.IsLightBase ? FlatStyle.Standard : FlatStyle.Flat;

            btnOpenSaveDirectory.BackColor = t.ButtonBg;
            btnOpenSaveDirectory.ForeColor = t.ButtonFg;
            btnOpenSaveDirectory.FlatStyle = t.IsLightBase ? FlatStyle.Standard : FlatStyle.Flat;

            // Launch Game stays green in every theme, always - it's never swept into the
            // generic per-theme button coloring above.
            btnLaunchGame.BackColor = Color.FromArgb(40, 140, 60);
            btnLaunchGame.ForeColor = Color.White;
            btnLaunchGame.FlatStyle = FlatStyle.Flat;

            chkSmartMatching.ForeColor = t.TextColor;
            chkSmartMatching.BackColor = Color.Transparent;

            chkAutoEngineIni.ForeColor = t.TextColor;
            chkAutoEngineIni.BackColor = Color.Transparent;

            pnlDropTarget.BackColor = t.ControlBg;
            lblDropInstruction.ForeColor = t.IsLightBase ? SystemColors.GrayText : TextMuted;

            txtServerSearchBox.Invalidate();
            txtModSearchBox.Invalidate();

            ApplyListBoxScrollbarTheme(t.UseDarkScrollbar);
            ApplyTitleBarTheme(t);

            // Refresh everything so the light-mode border wrappers (which check the theme at
            // paint time) show or hide immediately instead of waiting for some unrelated
            // repaint to happen to notice the theme changed.
            Invalidate(true);
        }

        private void ApplyListBoxScrollbarTheme(bool useDark)
        {
            try
            {
                SetWindowTheme(lstServerPaks.Handle, useDark ? "DarkMode_Explorer" : "Explorer", null);
            }
            catch { }
        }

        private void ApplyTitleBarTheme(ThemeColors t)
        {
            try
            {
                int useDark = t.DarkTitleBar ? 1 : 0;
                DwmSetWindowAttribute(Handle, DWMWA_USE_IMMERSIVE_DARK_MODE, ref useDark, sizeof(int));
            }
            catch { }

            try
            {
                int captionColorRef = ColorToColorRef(t.TitleBarColor);
                DwmSetWindowAttribute(Handle, DWMWA_CAPTION_COLOR, ref captionColorRef, sizeof(int));

                int textColorRef = ColorToColorRef(t.TitleBarTextColor);
                DwmSetWindowAttribute(Handle, DWMWA_TEXT_COLOR, ref textColorRef, sizeof(int));
            }
            catch { }
            // Both calls above are wrapped separately and swallow failures individually - on
            // Windows versions that don't support DWMWA_CAPTION_COLOR (pre-Windows 11), the
            // title bar still gets the dark/light toggle from the first call even though the
            // custom-color call fails.
        }

        private static int ColorToColorRef(Color c)
        {
            return c.R | (c.G << 8) | (c.B << 16);
        }

        private void ShowError(string context, Exception ex)
        {
            ShowThemedMessage("Mod Manager Error", "An error occurred while " + context + ".\n\nTechnical Details: " + ex.Message);
        }

        private void OnCheckboxSettingChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            UpdateDropInstructionText();
            SaveCheckboxSettings();
        }

        private void UpdateDropInstructionText()
        {
            string matchingPart = chkSmartMatching.Checked ? "Auto-extracts Paks, Reads Readmes" : "Auto-extracts Paks";
            string iniPart = chkAutoEngineIni.Checked ? " & Smart-Merges Engine.ini" : "";
            
            lblDropInstruction.Text = "Drag and Drop .pak, .zip or ReadMe Files Here\n\n(" + matchingPart + iniPart + ")";
        }

        private void LoadInitialPath()
        {
            if (File.Exists(ConfigFileName))
            {
                try
                {
                    string json = File.ReadAllText(ConfigFileName);
                    if (json.Contains("\"target_path\":"))
                    {
                        int start = json.IndexOf("\"target_path\":") + 14;
                        int firstQuote = json.IndexOf("\"", start);
                        int secondQuote = json.IndexOf("\"", firstQuote + 1);
                        if (firstQuote != -1 && secondQuote != -1)
                        {
                            txtGamePath.Text = json.Substring(firstQuote + 1, secondQuote - firstQuote - 1).Replace("\\\\", "\\");
                            return;
                        }
                    }
                }
                catch { }
            }
            txtGamePath.Text = DefaultGamePath;
        }

        private void PersistConfigPath(string path)
        {
            try
            {
                string json = "{\"target_path\":\"" + path.Replace("\\", "\\\\") + "\"}";
                File.WriteAllText(ConfigFileName, json);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                ShowError("Saving Configuration Settings", ex);
            }
        }

        private void ShowThemedMessage(string title, string message)
        {
            const int textWidth = 340;

            Size measured = TextRenderer.MeasureText(message, Font, new Size(textWidth, 0), TextFormatFlags.WordBreak);
            int textHeight = Math.Max(40, measured.Height);

            Form dlg = new Form
            {
                Text = title,
                FormBorderStyle = FormBorderStyle.FixedDialog,
                StartPosition = FormStartPosition.CenterParent,
                MaximizeBox = false,
                MinimizeBox = false,
                ClientSize = new Size(380, textHeight + 90)
            };

            Label lblMessage = new Label
            {
                Text = message,
                Location = new Point(20, 15),
                Size = new Size(textWidth, textHeight),
                AutoSize = false
            };
            dlg.Controls.Add(lblMessage);

            ShinyButton btnOk = new ShinyButton { Text = "OK", DialogResult = DialogResult.OK, Location = new Point(140, textHeight + 35), Width = 100, Height = 30 };
            dlg.Controls.Add(btnOk);
            dlg.AcceptButton = btnOk;
            dlg.CancelButton = btnOk;

            ApplyDialogTheme(dlg);
            dlg.ShowDialog(this);
        }


        private void OnBrowsePathClicked(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            using (FolderBrowserDialog dialog = new FolderBrowserDialog())
            {
                if (dialog.ShowDialog() == DialogResult.OK)
                {
                    txtGamePath.Text = dialog.SelectedPath;
                    PersistConfigPath(dialog.SelectedPath);
                }
            }
        }

        private void OnOpenDirectoryClicked(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            string path = txtGamePath.Text;
            if (Directory.Exists(path))
            {
                try { Process.Start("explorer.exe", path); }
                catch (Exception ex) { ShowError("Opening Game Directory in Windows Explorer", ex); }
            }
            else
            {
                MessageBox.Show("The specified folder directory does not exist.", "Folder Not Found", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Warning);
            }
        }

        private void OnOpenSaveDirectoryClicked(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            string savePath = Path.Combine(Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.LocalApplicationData), @"MotorTown\Saved\SaveGames");
            try
            {
                if (!Directory.Exists(savePath))
                {
                    Directory.CreateDirectory(savePath);
                }
                Process.Start("explorer.exe", savePath);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                ShowError("Opening Save File Directory in Windows Explorer", ex);
            }
        }

        private void RefreshServerList()
        {
            try
            {
                cachedServerFolders.Clear();
                cboServerDropdown.Items.Clear();

                foreach (var dir in Directory.GetDirectories(serverStorageDir))
                {
                    string folderName = Path.GetFileName(dir);
                    if (!folderName.Equals("Backup_Vanilla", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) &&
                        !folderName.Equals("Backup_Saves", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) &&
                        !folderName.Equals("Backup_CharacterSaves", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) &&
                        !folderName.Equals("MTModManager", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    {
                        cachedServerFolders.Add(folderName);
                    }
                }

                FilterServers(txtServerSearchBox.Text);

                if (cboServerDropdown.Items.Count > 0)
                    cboServerDropdown.SelectedIndex = 0;
                else
                    LoadSelectedServerPaks();
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                ShowError("Loading Server Folders List", ex);
            }
        }

        private void OnServerSearchChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            FilterServers(txtServerSearchBox.Text);
            if (cboServerDropdown.Items.Count > 0)
                cboServerDropdown.SelectedIndex = 0;
            else
                LoadSelectedServerPaks();
        }

        private void FilterServers(string query)
        {
            cboServerDropdown.Items.Clear();
            foreach (string server in cachedServerFolders)
            {
                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(query) || server.IndexOf(query, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0)
                {
                    cboServerDropdown.Items.Add(server);
                }
            }
        }

        private void LoadSelectedServerPaks()
        {
            try
            {
                cachedServerPaks.Clear();
                string serverName = (cboServerDropdown.SelectedItem != null) ? cboServerDropdown.SelectedItem.ToString() : null;

                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(serverName))
                {
                    string targetDir = Path.Combine(serverStorageDir, serverName);
                    if (Directory.Exists(targetDir))
                    {
                        foreach (string file in Directory.GetFiles(targetDir, "*.pak"))
                        {
                            cachedServerPaks.Add(Path.GetFileName(file));
                        }
                    }
                }

                FilterMods(txtModSearchBox.Text);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                ShowError("Listing Mod Files for Selected Server", ex);
            }
        }

        private void OnModSearchChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            FilterMods(txtModSearchBox.Text);
        }

        private void FilterMods(string query)
        {
            lstServerPaks.Items.Clear();
            foreach (string pak in cachedServerPaks)
            {
                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(query) || pak.IndexOf(query, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0)
                {
                    lstServerPaks.Items.Add(pak);
                }
            }
        }

        private void OnAddServerClicked(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            string name = Interaction.InputBox("Enter the new server folder name:", "Add Server", "");
            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(name))
            {
                try
                {
                    string trimmedName = name.Trim();
                    if (trimmedName.Equals("Backup_Vanilla", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                        trimmedName.Equals("Backup_Saves", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                        trimmedName.Equals("Backup_CharacterSaves", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    {
                        MessageBox.Show("That name is reserved for system backups.", "Invalid Name", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Warning);
                        return;
                    }

                    Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.Combine(serverStorageDir, trimmedName));
                    txtServerSearchBox.Text = "";
                    RefreshServerList();
                    cboServerDropdown.SelectedItem = trimmedName;
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    ShowError("Creating New Server Folder", ex);
                }
            }
        }

        private void OnDeleteServerClicked(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            string serverName = (cboServerDropdown.SelectedItem != null) ? cboServerDropdown.SelectedItem.ToString() : "";
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(serverName))
            {
                MessageBox.Show("Please select a server folder to delete.", "Notice");
                return;
            }

            string serverDirPath = Path.Combine(serverStorageDir, serverName);

            if (MessageBox.Show("Are you sure you want to delete the entire server folder '" + serverName + "' and all its stored mod paks?", "Confirm Delete Server", MessageBoxButtons.YesNo, MessageBoxIcon.Warning) == DialogResult.Yes)
            {
                try
                {
                    if (Directory.Exists(serverDirPath))
                    {
                        Directory.Delete(serverDirPath, true);
                        RefreshServerList();
                        MessageBox.Show("Successfully deleted server folder '" + serverName + "'.", "Success");
                    }
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    ShowError("Deleting Server Folder", ex);
                }
            }
        }

        private void OnDeleteModClicked(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            if (lstServerPaks.SelectedItem == null)
            {
                MessageBox.Show("Please select a .pak file from the list to delete.", "Notice");
                return;
            }

            string serverName = (cboServerDropdown.SelectedItem != null) ? cboServerDropdown.SelectedItem.ToString() : "";
            string fileName = lstServerPaks.SelectedItem.ToString();
            string filePath = Path.Combine(serverStorageDir, serverName, fileName);

            if (MessageBox.Show("Are you sure you want to delete '" + fileName + "'?", "Confirm Delete", MessageBoxButtons.YesNo, MessageBoxIcon.Warning) == DialogResult.Yes)
            {
                try
                {
                    if (File.Exists(filePath))
                    {
                        File.Delete(filePath);
                        LoadSelectedServerPaks();
                        MessageBox.Show("Successfully deleted '" + fileName + "'.", "Success");
                    }
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    ShowError("Deleting Selected Mod File", ex);
                }
            }
        }

        private void OnMergeServerModsClicked(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            if (cachedServerFolders.Count < 2)
            {
                MessageBox.Show("You need at least two server folders to perform a merge.", "Insufficient Servers", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Warning);
                return;
            }

            Form mergeForm = new Form
            {
                Text = "Merge Server Mods",
                Width = 720,
                Height = 560,
                StartPosition = FormStartPosition.CenterParent,
                MinimizeBox = false,
                MaximizeBox = false
            };

            Label lblServer1 = new Label { Text = "First Server:", Location = new Point(15, 15), AutoSize = true, Font = new Font(FontFamily.GenericSansSerif, 9, FontStyle.Bold) };
            ComboBox cboServer1 = new ComboBox { Location = new Point(105, 12), Width = 210, DropDownStyle = ComboBoxStyle.DropDownList };
            
            Label lblServer2 = new Label { Text = "Second Server:", Location = new Point(340, 15), AutoSize = true, Font = new Font(FontFamily.GenericSansSerif, 9, FontStyle.Bold) };
            ComboBox cboServer2 = new ComboBox { Location = new Point(460, 12), Width = 210, DropDownStyle = ComboBoxStyle.DropDownList };

            foreach (string s in cachedServerFolders)
            {
                cboServer1.Items.Add(s);
                cboServer2.Items.Add(s);
            }

            if (cboServer1.Items.Count > 0) cboServer1.SelectedIndex = 0;
            if (cboServer2.Items.Count > 1) cboServer2.SelectedIndex = 1;
            else if (cboServer2.Items.Count > 0) cboServer2.SelectedIndex = 0;

            CheckedListBox chkListLeft = new CheckedListBox { Location = new Point(15, 50), Size = new Size(320, 380), CheckOnClick = true, Anchor = AnchorStyles.Top | AnchorStyles.Bottom | AnchorStyles.Left };
            CheckedListBox chkListRight = new CheckedListBox { Location = new Point(365, 50), Size = new Size(320, 380), CheckOnClick = true, Anchor = AnchorStyles.Top | AnchorStyles.Bottom | AnchorStyles.Right };

            Action loadLeftPaks = delegate
            {
                chkListLeft.Items.Clear();
                string sName = cboServer1.SelectedItem as string;
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(sName))
                {
                    string dir = Path.Combine(serverStorageDir, sName);
                    if (Directory.Exists(dir))
                    {
                        foreach (string f in Directory.GetFiles(dir, "*.pak"))
                        {
                            chkListLeft.Items.Add(Path.GetFileName(f), true);
                        }
                    }
                }
            };

            Action loadRightPaks = delegate
            {
                chkListRight.Items.Clear();
                string sName = cboServer2.SelectedItem as string;
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(sName))
                {
                    string dir = Path.Combine(serverStorageDir, sName);
                    if (Directory.Exists(dir))
                    {
                        foreach (string f in Directory.GetFiles(dir, "*.pak"))
                        {
                            chkListRight.Items.Add(Path.GetFileName(f), true);
                        }
                    }
                }
            };

            cboServer1.SelectedIndexChanged += delegate { loadLeftPaks(); };
            cboServer2.SelectedIndexChanged += delegate { loadRightPaks(); };

            loadLeftPaks();
            loadRightPaks();

            Button btnExecuteMerge = new ShinyButton
            {
                Text = "Execute Merge/Create New Server",
                Location = new Point(15, 450),
                Width = 670,
                Height = 36,
                FlatStyle = FlatStyle.Flat,
                Anchor = AnchorStyles.Bottom | AnchorStyles.Left | AnchorStyles.Right,
                Font = new Font(FontFamily.GenericSansSerif, 9.5f, FontStyle.Bold)
            };

            btnExecuteMerge.Click += delegate
            {
                string newServerName = Interaction.InputBox("Enter name for the new merged server folder:", "New Server Name", "MergedServer");
                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(newServerName)) return;

                string trimmedName = newServerName.Trim();
                if (trimmedName.Equals("Backup_Vanilla", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                    trimmedName.Equals("Backup_Saves", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                    trimmedName.Equals("Backup_CharacterSaves", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                {
                    MessageBox.Show("That name is reserved for system backups.", "Invalid Name", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Warning);
                    return;
                }

                string newServerDirPath = Path.Combine(serverStorageDir, trimmedName);
                if (Directory.Exists(newServerDirPath))
                {
                    MessageBox.Show("A server folder with that name already exists.", "Error", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);
                    return;
                }

                try
                {
                    Directory.CreateDirectory(newServerDirPath);
                    Dictionary<string, string> uniqueMods = new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

                    string s1Dir = Path.Combine(serverStorageDir, cboServer1.SelectedItem.ToString());
                    foreach (var item in chkListLeft.CheckedItems)
                    {
                        string fileName = item.ToString();
                        string sourcePath = Path.Combine(s1Dir, fileName);
                        string baseName = ExtractBaseModName(fileName);

                        if (uniqueMods.ContainsKey(baseName))
                        {
                            string existingPath = uniqueMods[baseName];
                            DateTime existingDate = File.GetLastWriteTimeUtc(existingPath);
                            DateTime incomingDate = File.GetLastWriteTimeUtc(sourcePath);
                            if (incomingDate > existingDate)
                            {
                                uniqueMods[baseName] = sourcePath;
                            }
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            uniqueMods[baseName] = sourcePath;
                        }
                    }

                    string s2Dir = Path.Combine(serverStorageDir, cboServer2.SelectedItem.ToString());
                    foreach (var item in chkListRight.CheckedItems)
                    {
                        string fileName = item.ToString();
                        string sourcePath = Path.Combine(s2Dir, fileName);
                        string baseName = ExtractBaseModName(fileName);

                        if (uniqueMods.ContainsKey(baseName))
                        {
                            string existingPath = uniqueMods[baseName];
                            DateTime existingDate = File.GetLastWriteTimeUtc(existingPath);
                            DateTime incomingDate = File.GetLastWriteTimeUtc(sourcePath);
                            if (incomingDate > existingDate)
                            {
                                uniqueMods[baseName] = sourcePath;
                            }
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            uniqueMods[baseName] = sourcePath;
                        }
                    }

                    int copiedCount = 0;
                    foreach (var kvp in uniqueMods)
                    {
                        string src = kvp.Value;
                        string dest = Path.Combine(newServerDirPath, Path.GetFileName(src));
                        File.Copy(src, dest, true);
                        copiedCount++;
                    }

                    RefreshServerList();
                    cboServerDropdown.SelectedItem = trimmedName;
                    mergeForm.Close();
                    MessageBox.Show("Successfully created merged server '" + trimmedName + "' with " + copiedCount + " unique/updated mod(s).", "Merge Complete", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Information);
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    ShowError("Merging Server Mods", ex);
                }
            };

            mergeForm.Controls.Add(lblServer1);
            mergeForm.Controls.Add(cboServer1);
            mergeForm.Controls.Add(lblServer2);
            mergeForm.Controls.Add(cboServer2);
            mergeForm.Controls.Add(chkListLeft);
            mergeForm.Controls.Add(chkListRight);
            mergeForm.Controls.Add(btnExecuteMerge);

            ApplyDialogTheme(mergeForm);
            mergeForm.ShowDialog(this);
        }

        private string ExtractBaseModName(string filename)
        {
            string name = Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(filename);

            if (name.EndsWith("_P", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            {
                name = name.Substring(0, name.Length - 2);
            }

            name = Regex.Replace(name, @"^[zZ]+_?", "", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase);
            name = Regex.Replace(name, @"[_\-\.]?v?\d+[\d\.\-T_r]*$", "", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase);

            return name.ToLower().Trim();
        }

        private bool IsReadmeFile(string fileName)
        {
            string fileNameOnly = Path.GetFileName(fileName);
            return Regex.IsMatch(fileNameOnly, @"^.*read.*m*e*.*\.(txt|md|rtf|log)$", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase) || 
                   Regex.IsMatch(fileNameOnly, @"^readme.*$", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase);
        }

        private void OnPanelDragEnter(object sender, DragEventArgs e)
        {
            if (e.Data.GetDataPresent(DataFormats.FileDrop) || 
                e.Data.GetDataPresent("FileGroupDescriptorW"))
            {
                e.Effect = DragDropEffects.Copy;
                ShowDragOverlay();
            }
            else
            {
                e.Effect = DragDropEffects.None;
            }
        }

        private void AnyControl_DragLeave(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            // Debounced: moving from one child control to another fires DragLeave on the first
            // immediately followed by DragEnter on the second within the same message pump, so
            // delay the hide briefly and let a fresh DragEnter cancel it - avoids overlay flicker
            // while dragging across the window instead of only truly leaving it.
            dragLeaveTimer.Stop();
            dragLeaveTimer.Start();
        }

        private void ShowDragOverlay()
        {
            dragLeaveTimer.Stop();
            if (!pnlDragOverlay.Visible)
            {
                pnlDragOverlay.Visible = true;
                pnlDragOverlay.BringToFront();
            }
            Opacity = 0.88;
        }

        private void HideDragOverlay()
        {
            pnlDragOverlay.Visible = false;
            Opacity = 1.0;
        }

        private void OnPanelDragDrop(object sender, DragEventArgs e)
        {
            dragLeaveTimer.Stop();
            HideDragOverlay();

            string serverName = (cboServerDropdown.SelectedItem != null) ? cboServerDropdown.SelectedItem.ToString() : null;

            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(serverName))
            {
                serverName = Interaction.InputBox("Enter target server name for these files:", "New Server", "");
                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(serverName)) return;

                try
                {
                    string trimmedName = serverName.Trim();
                    if (trimmedName.Equals("Backup_Vanilla", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                        trimmedName.Equals("Backup_Saves", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                        trimmedName.Equals("Backup_CharacterSaves", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    {
                        MessageBox.Show("That name is reserved for system backups.", "Invalid Name", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Warning);
                        return;
                    }

                    Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.Combine(serverStorageDir, trimmedName));
                    txtServerSearchBox.Text = "";
                    RefreshServerList();
                    cboServerDropdown.SelectedItem = trimmedName;
                    serverName = trimmedName;
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    ShowError("Creating Target Server Directory", ex);
                    return;
                }
            }

            string targetServerPath = Path.Combine(serverStorageDir, serverName);
            int processedCount = 0;
            string tempExtractDir = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), "MotorTownModManager_" + Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N"));

            try
            {
                List<string> filesToProcess = new List<string>();

                // Handle Standard Physical File Drops (.zip, .pak, loose files) - checked first.
                // Explorer commonly advertises "FileGroupDescriptorW" even for ordinary files
                // dragged straight off disk, not just genuine virtual sources (e.g. dragging
                // out of an open zip-preview window). If we checked that format first, real
                // file drops would get routed into the virtual-stream path, which can't
                // retrieve their actual content - so nothing gets imported. Checking FileDrop
                // first ensures normal drags are handled the reliable, direct way.
                if (e.Data.GetDataPresent(DataFormats.FileDrop))
                {
                    string[] paths = (string[])e.Data.GetData(DataFormats.FileDrop);

                    foreach (string path in paths)
                    {
                        if (File.Exists(path))
                        {
                            string fileName = Path.GetFileName(path);
                            string ext = Path.GetExtension(path);

                            if (ext.Equals(".pak", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                            {
                                filesToProcess.Add(path);
                            }
                            else if (IsReadmeFile(fileName))
                            {
                                try
                                {
                                    ShowReadmeWindow(fileName, File.ReadAllText(path));
                                }
                                catch (Exception ex)
                                {
                                    ShowError("Reading Loose Readme File '" + fileName + "'", ex);
                                }
                            }
                            else if (ext.Equals(".zip", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                            {
                                try
                                {
                                    Directory.CreateDirectory(tempExtractDir);
                                    SafeExtractZip(path, tempExtractDir);

                                    foreach (string extractedFile in Directory.GetFiles(tempExtractDir, "*", SearchOption.AllDirectories))
                                    {
                                        string extractedFileName = Path.GetFileName(extractedFile);
                                        string extractedExt = Path.GetExtension(extractedFile);

                                        if (IsReadmeFile(extractedFileName))
                                        {
                                            try { ShowReadmeWindow(extractedFileName, File.ReadAllText(extractedFile)); } catch { }
                                        }
                                        else if (extractedFileName.Equals("Engine.ini", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) && chkAutoEngineIni.Checked)
                                        {
                                            ProcessEngineIni(extractedFile);
                                        }
                                        else if (extractedExt.Equals(".pak", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                                        {
                                            if (!filesToProcess.Contains(extractedFile))
                                            {
                                                filesToProcess.Add(extractedFile);
                                            }
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                                catch (Exception ex)
                                {
                                    ShowError("Extracting Zip Archive '" + Path.GetFileName(path) + "'", ex);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                // Handle Virtual File Stream Drops (dragging files directly out of an open Zip
                // window) - only reached when this isn't a normal physical file drop.
                else if (e.Data.GetDataPresent("FileGroupDescriptorW") && e.Data.GetDataPresent("FileContents"))
                {
                    Directory.CreateDirectory(tempExtractDir);
                    Stream stream = (Stream)e.Data.GetData("FileGroupDescriptorW");
                    if (stream != null)
                    {
                        byte[] buffer = new byte[stream.Length];
                        stream.Read(buffer, 0, buffer.Length);

                        int fileCount = BitConverter.ToInt32(buffer, 0);
                        int offset = 4;

                        for (int i = 0; i < fileCount; i++)
                        {
                            string fileName = System.Text.Encoding.Unicode.GetString(buffer, offset + 76, 520).TrimEnd('\0');
                            offset += 592; // Size of FILEDESCRIPTORW structure

                            byte[] fileBytes = GetVirtualFileContents(e.Data, i);
                            if (fileBytes != null)
                            {
                                string extractedFilePath = SafeCombineWithinDirectory(tempExtractDir, fileName);
                                if (extractedFilePath == null)
                                {
                                    continue; // suspicious/unsafe name in virtual drop data - skip it
                                }
                                File.WriteAllBytes(extractedFilePath, fileBytes);

                                string ext = Path.GetExtension(extractedFilePath);
                                if (ext.Equals(".pak", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                                {
                                    filesToProcess.Add(extractedFilePath);
                                }
