                                else if (IsReadmeFile(fileName))
                                {
                                    try { ShowReadmeWindow(fileName, File.ReadAllText(extractedFilePath)); } catch { }
                                }
                                else if (ext.Equals(".zip", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                                {
                                    try
                                    {
                                        string innerExtractDir = Path.Combine(tempExtractDir, "inner_" + Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N"));
                                        Directory.CreateDirectory(innerExtractDir);
                                        SafeExtractZip(extractedFilePath, innerExtractDir);

                                        foreach (string extractedFile in Directory.GetFiles(innerExtractDir, "*", SearchOption.AllDirectories))
                                        {
                                            string innerFileName = Path.GetFileName(extractedFile);
                                            string innerExt = Path.GetExtension(extractedFile);

                                            if (IsReadmeFile(innerFileName))
                                            {
                                                try { ShowReadmeWindow(innerFileName, File.ReadAllText(extractedFile)); } catch { }
                                            }
                                            else if (innerFileName.Equals("Engine.ini", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) && chkAutoEngineIni.Checked)
                                            {
                                                ProcessEngineIni(extractedFile);
                                            }
                                            else if (innerExt.Equals(".pak", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                                            {
                                                if (!filesToProcess.Contains(extractedFile))
                                                {
                                                    filesToProcess.Add(extractedFile);
                                                }
                                            }
                                        }
                                    }
                                    catch (Exception ex)
                                    {
                                        ShowError("Extracting Dropped Zip Archive '" + fileName + "'", ex);
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                foreach (string file in filesToProcess)
                {
                    try
                    {
                        string incomingFileName = Path.GetFileName(file);

                        if (incomingFileName.Equals("MotorTown-Windows.pak", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        {
                            continue;
                        }

                        if (!chkSmartMatching.Checked)
                        {
                            File.Copy(file, Path.Combine(targetServerPath, incomingFileName), true);
                            processedCount++;
                            continue;
                        }

                        string incomingBaseName = ExtractBaseModName(incomingFileName);
                        string[] existingFiles = Directory.GetFiles(targetServerPath, "*.pak");
                        string matchPath = null;

                        foreach (string existing in existingFiles)
                        {
                            if (ExtractBaseModName(Path.GetFileName(existing)) == incomingBaseName)
                            {
                                matchPath = existing;
                                break;
                            }
                        }

                        if (matchPath != null)
                        {
                            string existingFileName = Path.GetFileName(matchPath);

                            if (existingFileName.Equals(incomingFileName, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                            {
                                File.Copy(file, Path.Combine(targetServerPath, incomingFileName), true);
                                processedCount++;
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                DateTime existingDate = File.GetLastWriteTimeUtc(matchPath);
                                DateTime incomingDate = File.GetLastWriteTimeUtc(file);

                                string comparisonNote = incomingDate > existingDate
                                    ? "• NEW file is newer (Modified: " + incomingDate.ToLocalTime() + ")\n  than existing file (Modified: " + existingDate.ToLocalTime() + ")"
                                    : "• NEW file is older or same (Modified: " + incomingDate.ToLocalTime() + ")\n  than existing file (Modified: " + existingDate.ToLocalTime() + ")";

                                string prompt = "Existing version of this mod detected:\n\n" +
                                                "Existing: " + existingFileName + "\n" +
                                                "Incoming: " + incomingFileName + "\n\n" +
                                                "File Properties:\n" + comparisonNote + "\n\n" +
                                                "Replace old version with the new one?";

                                if (MessageBox.Show(prompt, "Version Conflict Detected", MessageBoxButtons.YesNo, MessageBoxIcon.Question) == DialogResult.Yes)
                                {
                                    File.Delete(matchPath);
                                    File.Copy(file, Path.Combine(targetServerPath, incomingFileName), true);
                                    processedCount++;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            File.Copy(file, Path.Combine(targetServerPath, incomingFileName), true);
                            processedCount++;
                        }
                    }
                    catch (Exception ex)
                    {
                        ShowError("Processing File '" + Path.GetFileName(file) + "'", ex);
                    }
                }
            }
            finally
            {
                try
                {
                    if (Directory.Exists(tempExtractDir))
                        Directory.Delete(tempExtractDir, true);
                }
                catch { }
            }

            LoadSelectedServerPaks();
            if (processedCount > 0)
            {
                MessageBox.Show("Successfully processed " + processedCount + " .pak file(s) for server '" + serverName + "'.", "Success");
            }
        }

        private void ShowReadmeWindow(string title, string content)
        {
            Form readmeForm = new Form
            {
                Text = "Mod Instructions - " + title,
                Width = 500,
                Height = 450,
                StartPosition = FormStartPosition.CenterParent,
                MinimizeBox = false,
                MaximizeBox = false
            };

            TextBox txtContent = new TextBox
            {
                Multiline = true,
                ReadOnly = true,
                ScrollBars = ScrollBars.Vertical,
                Dock = DockStyle.Fill,
                Text = content,
                Font = new Font(FontFamily.GenericMonospace, 9.5f)
            };

            Button btnOk = new ShinyButton
            {
                Text = "OK (Press Enter)",
                Dock = DockStyle.Bottom,
                Height = 35,
                DialogResult = DialogResult.OK
            };
            btnOk.Click += delegate(object s, EventArgs e) { readmeForm.Close(); };

            readmeForm.Controls.Add(txtContent);
            readmeForm.Controls.Add(btnOk);
            readmeForm.AcceptButton = btnOk;

            ApplyDialogTheme(readmeForm);
            readmeForm.ShowDialog(this);
        }

        private void ProcessEngineIni(string newIniPath)
        {
            try
            {
                string targetEngineIniPath;
                if (!EnsureEngineIniExists(out targetEngineIniPath))
                {
                    return;
                }

                string targetIniDir = Path.GetDirectoryName(targetEngineIniPath);
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(targetIniDir) && !Directory.Exists(targetIniDir))
                {
                    Directory.CreateDirectory(targetIniDir);
                }

                if (File.Exists(targetEngineIniPath))
                {
                    File.SetAttributes(targetEngineIniPath, FileAttributes.Normal);
                }

                Dictionary<string, string> existingSettings = new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
                List<string> existingLines = new List<string>();

                if (File.Exists(targetEngineIniPath))
                {
                    existingLines = new List<string>(File.ReadAllLines(targetEngineIniPath));
                    foreach (string line in existingLines)
                    {
                        string trimmed = line.Trim();
                        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(trimmed) && !trimmed.StartsWith(";") && !trimmed.StartsWith("#") && trimmed.Contains("="))
                        {
                            int idx = trimmed.IndexOf('=');
                            string key = trimmed.Substring(0, idx).Trim();
                            string val = trimmed.Substring(idx + 1).Trim();
                            existingSettings[key] = val;
                        }
                    }
                }

                Dictionary<string, string> incomingSettings = new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
                List<string> incomingLines = new List<string>(File.ReadAllLines(newIniPath));
                foreach (string line in incomingLines)
                {
                    string trimmed = line.Trim();
                    if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(trimmed) && !trimmed.StartsWith(";") && !trimmed.StartsWith("#") && trimmed.Contains("="))
                    {
                        int idx = trimmed.IndexOf('=');
                        string key = trimmed.Substring(0, idx).Trim();
                        string val = trimmed.Substring(idx + 1).Trim();
                        incomingSettings[key] = val;
                    }
                }

                List<string> mergedLines = new List<string>(existingLines);
                System.Text.StringBuilder comparisonLog = new System.Text.StringBuilder();
                comparisonLog.AppendLine("Engine.ini Smart Merge Analysis:\n");

                foreach (var kvp in incomingSettings)
                {
                    string key = kvp.Key;
                    string incomingValStr = kvp.Value;

                    if (existingSettings.ContainsKey(key))
                    {
                        string existingValStr = existingSettings[key];

                        if (key.IndexOf("winch", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0 || 
                            key.IndexOf("length", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0 ||
                            key.IndexOf("rope", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0)
                        {
                            float incNum, extNum;
                            if (float.TryParse(incomingValStr, out incNum) && float.TryParse(existingValStr, out extNum))
                            {
                                if (incNum > extNum)
                                {
                                    comparisonLog.AppendLine("[WINCH / LENGTH] " + key + ":\n  Existing: " + existingValStr + "\n  Incoming: " + incomingValStr + "\n  -> Updated to larger value (" + incomingValStr + ")\n");
                                    UpdateOrCreateLine(mergedLines, key, incomingValStr);
                                }
                                else
                                {
                                    comparisonLog.AppendLine("[WINCH / LENGTH] " + key + ":\n  Existing: " + existingValStr + "\n  Incoming: " + incomingValStr + "\n  -> Kept larger existing value (" + existingValStr + ")\n");
                                }
                                continue;
                            }
                        }

                        if (existingValStr != incomingValStr)
                        {
                            comparisonLog.AppendLine("[MODIFIED] " + key + ":\n  Existing: " + existingValStr + "\n  Incoming: " + incomingValStr + "\n");
                            UpdateOrCreateLine(mergedLines, key, incomingValStr);
                        }
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        comparisonLog.AppendLine("[NEW] " + key + " = " + incomingValStr + "\n");
                        mergedLines.Add(key + "=" + incomingValStr);
                    }
                }

                Form diffForm = new Form
                {
                    Text = "Engine.ini Changes Approval",
                    Width = 550,
                    Height = 480,
                    StartPosition = FormStartPosition.CenterParent,
                    MinimizeBox = false,
                    MaximizeBox = false
                };

                Label lblHeader = new Label
                {
                    Text = "A mod included an Engine.ini file. Review proposed changes below:",
                    Dock = DockStyle.Top,
                    Height = 25,
                    TextAlign = ContentAlignment.MiddleLeft,
                    Font = new Font(FontFamily.GenericSansSerif, 9, FontStyle.Bold)
                };

                TextBox txtDiff = new TextBox
                {
                    Multiline = true,
                    ReadOnly = true,
                    ScrollBars = ScrollBars.Vertical,
                    Dock = DockStyle.Fill,
                    Text = comparisonLog.ToString(),
                    Font = new Font(FontFamily.GenericMonospace, 9)
                };

                Panel pnlButtons = new Panel { Dock = DockStyle.Bottom, Height = 40 };
                Button btnApprove = new ShinyButton { Text = "Approve Edits", DialogResult = DialogResult.Yes, Width = 150, Height = 30, Location = new Point(105, 5) };
                Button btnCancel = new ShinyButton { Text = "Skip Edits", DialogResult = DialogResult.No, Width = 150, Height = 30, Location = new Point(285, 5) };

                pnlButtons.Controls.Add(btnApprove);
                pnlButtons.Controls.Add(btnCancel);

                diffForm.Controls.Add(txtDiff);
                diffForm.Controls.Add(lblHeader);
                diffForm.Controls.Add(pnlButtons);
                diffForm.AcceptButton = btnApprove;
                diffForm.CancelButton = btnCancel;

                ApplyDialogTheme(diffForm);
                if (diffForm.ShowDialog(this) == DialogResult.Yes)
                {
                    File.WriteAllLines(targetEngineIniPath, mergedLines);
                    File.SetAttributes(targetEngineIniPath, FileAttributes.ReadOnly);

                    MessageBox.Show("Engine.ini successfully updated, merged, and locked as Read-Only.", "Success", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Information);
                }
                else
                {
                    if (File.Exists(targetEngineIniPath))
                    {
                        File.SetAttributes(targetEngineIniPath, FileAttributes.ReadOnly);
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                ShowError("Processing Engine.ini Configuration", ex);
            }
        }

        private void UpdateOrCreateLine(List<string> lines, string key, string newValue)
        {
            bool found = false;
            for (int i = 0; i < lines.Count; i++)
            {
                string trimmed = lines[i].Trim();
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(trimmed) && !trimmed.StartsWith(";") && trimmed.StartsWith(key, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                {
                    int idx = trimmed.IndexOf('=');
                    if (idx != -1 && trimmed.Substring(0, idx).Trim().Equals(key, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    {
                        lines[i] = key + "=" + newValue;
                        found = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            if (!found)
            {
                lines.Add(key + "=" + newValue);
            }
        }

        private void OnOpenEngineIniClicked(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            string targetEngineIniPath;
            if (!EnsureEngineIniExists(out targetEngineIniPath))
            {
                return;
            }

            try
            {
                string targetIniDir = Path.GetDirectoryName(targetEngineIniPath);
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(targetIniDir) && !Directory.Exists(targetIniDir))
                {
                    Directory.CreateDirectory(targetIniDir);
                }

                if (File.Exists(targetEngineIniPath))
                {
                    File.SetAttributes(targetEngineIniPath, FileAttributes.Normal);
                }
                else
                {
                    File.WriteAllText(targetEngineIniPath, "; Motor Town Engine.ini Config\n");
                }

                string selectedEditor = (cboEditorSelector.SelectedItem != null) ? cboEditorSelector.SelectedItem.ToString() : "Windows Notepad";
                
                if (selectedEditor.Equals("Notepad++", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                {
                    string nppPath = @"C:\Program Files\Notepad++\notepad++.exe";
                    if (!File.Exists(nppPath)) nppPath = @"C:\Program Files (x86)\Notepad++\notepad++.exe";
                    
                    if (File.Exists(nppPath))
                    {
                        Process.Start(nppPath, "\"" + targetEngineIniPath + "\"");
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        MessageBox.Show("Notepad++ executable could not be found in standard paths. Falling back to Windows Notepad.", "Editor Not Found", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Warning);
                        Process.Start("notepad.exe", targetEngineIniPath);
                    }
                }
                else if (selectedEditor.Equals("VS Code", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                {
                    string codePath = Path.Combine(Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.LocalApplicationData), @"Programs\Microsoft VS Code\Code.exe");
                    if (!File.Exists(codePath)) codePath = @"C:\Program Files\Microsoft VS Code\Code.exe";

                    if (File.Exists(codePath))
                    {
                        Process.Start(codePath, "\"" + targetEngineIniPath + "\"");
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        MessageBox.Show("VS Code executable could not be found in standard paths. Falling back to Windows Notepad.", "Editor Not Found", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Warning);
                        Process.Start("notepad.exe", targetEngineIniPath);
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    Process.Start("notepad.exe", targetEngineIniPath);
                }
                
                MessageBox.Show("Engine.ini has been unlocked for editing.\n\nClick OK once you are finished editing to lock it back to Read-Only automatically.", "Engine.ini Unlocked", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Information);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                ShowError("Opening Engine.ini", ex);
            }
            finally
            {
                try
                {
                    if (File.Exists(targetEngineIniPath))
                    {
                        File.SetAttributes(targetEngineIniPath, FileAttributes.ReadOnly);
                    }
                }
                catch { }
            }
        }

        private void OnDeployModsClicked(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            string serverName = (cboServerDropdown.SelectedItem != null) ? cboServerDropdown.SelectedItem.ToString() : null;
            string gamePath = txtGamePath.Text;

            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(serverName))
            {
                MessageBox.Show("Please select or create a server first.", "Error");
                return;
            }

            if (!Directory.Exists(gamePath))
            {
                MessageBox.Show("Target game directory does not exist.", "Error", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);
                return;
            }

            if (MessageBox.Show("This will clear out existing mod paks in your game folder and deploy '" + serverName + "' mods.\n\nProceed?", "Deploy Mods", MessageBoxButtons.YesNo, MessageBoxIcon.Warning) != DialogResult.Yes)
                return;

            try
            {
                foreach (string pak in Directory.GetFiles(gamePath, "*.pak"))
                {
                    if (!Path.GetFileName(pak).Equals("MotorTown-Windows.pak", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    {
                        File.Delete(pak);
                    }
                }

                string sourceDir = Path.Combine(serverStorageDir, serverName);
                int deployedCount = 0;

                foreach (string pak in Directory.GetFiles(sourceDir, "*.pak"))
                {
                    File.Copy(pak, Path.Combine(gamePath, Path.GetFileName(pak)), true);
                    deployedCount++;
                }

                MessageBox.Show("Successfully deployed " + deployedCount + " mod file(s) from server '" + serverName + "'.", "Success");
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                ShowError("Deploying Mods to Game Directory", ex);
            }
        }

        private void OnRevertVanillaClicked(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            string gamePath = txtGamePath.Text;

            if (!Directory.Exists(gamePath))
            {
                MessageBox.Show("Target game directory does not exist.", "Error", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);
                return;
            }

            if (MessageBox.Show("This will remove all installed mods from your game folder and restore vanilla configuration.\n\nProceed?", "Revert to Vanilla", MessageBoxButtons.YesNo, MessageBoxIcon.Warning) != DialogResult.Yes)
                return;

            try
            {
                int removedCount = 0;
                foreach (string pak in Directory.GetFiles(gamePath, "*.pak"))
                {
                    if (!Path.GetFileName(pak).Equals("MotorTown-Windows.pak", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    {
                        File.Delete(pak);
                        removedCount++;
                    }
                }

                MessageBox.Show("Successfully removed " + removedCount + " mod file(s). Game restored to clean vanilla state.", "Success", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Information);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                ShowError("Removing Mods from Game Directory", ex);
            }
        }

        private async void OnBackupPaksClicked(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            string gamePath = txtGamePath.Text;

            if (!Directory.Exists(gamePath))
            {
                MessageBox.Show("Target game directory does not exist.", "Error", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);
                return;
            }

            string sourceFile = Path.Combine(gamePath, "MotorTown-Windows.pak");

            if (!File.Exists(sourceFile))
            {
                MessageBox.Show("Could not find 'MotorTown-Windows.pak' in the target game directory.", "Backup Failed", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);
                return;
            }

            ShowBusyOverlay("Backing up MotorTown-Windows.pak...");
            try
            {
                if (!Directory.Exists(backupStorageDir))
                    Directory.CreateDirectory(backupStorageDir);

                string destFile = Path.Combine(backupStorageDir, "MotorTown-Windows.pak");

                // This file is large enough that a synchronous File.Copy on the UI thread
                // would freeze the whole window for the duration - running it on a
                // background thread keeps the app responsive while the overlay spins.
                await Task.Run(delegate { File.Copy(sourceFile, destFile, true); });

                MessageBox.Show("Successfully backed up 'MotorTown-Windows.pak' to 'ServerMods\\Backup_Vanilla'.", "Backup Complete", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Information);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                ShowError("Backing Up Game Pak", ex);
            }
            finally
            {
                HideBusyOverlay();
            }
        }

        private async void OnRestoreBackupClicked(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            string gamePath = txtGamePath.Text;

            if (!Directory.Exists(gamePath))
            {
                MessageBox.Show("Target game directory does not exist.", "Error", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);
                return;
            }

            string sourceBackupFile = Path.Combine(backupStorageDir, "MotorTown-Windows.pak");

            if (!File.Exists(sourceBackupFile))
            {
                MessageBox.Show("No backup file found for 'MotorTown-Windows.pak' inside 'ServerMods\\Backup_Vanilla'. Please run 'Backup Main Game File' first.", "No Backup Found", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Warning);
                return;
            }

            if (MessageBox.Show("This will overwrite your current game core package ('MotorTown-Windows.pak') with your saved backup version. Proceed?", "Restore Backup", MessageBoxButtons.YesNo, MessageBoxIcon.Warning) != DialogResult.Yes)
                return;

            ShowBusyOverlay("Restoring MotorTown-Windows.pak...");
            try
            {
                string destFile = Path.Combine(gamePath, "MotorTown-Windows.pak");
                await Task.Run(delegate { File.Copy(sourceBackupFile, destFile, true); });

                MessageBox.Show("Successfully restored 'MotorTown-Windows.pak' from backup.", "Restore Complete", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Information);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                ShowError("Restoring Game Pak from Backup", ex);
            }
            finally
            {
                HideBusyOverlay();
            }
        }

        private void OnBackupSavesClicked(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            string charactersDir = Path.Combine(Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.LocalApplicationData), @"MotorTown\Saved\SaveGames\Characters");

            if (!Directory.Exists(charactersDir))
            {
                ShowThemedMessage("Backup Failed", "Characters save directory could not be found at:\n" + charactersDir);
                return;
            }

            try
            {
                if (!Directory.Exists(saveGameBackupDir))
                    Directory.CreateDirectory(saveGameBackupDir);

                string[] saveFiles = Directory.GetFiles(charactersDir, "*.sav");
                int backedUpCount = 0;

                foreach (string file in saveFiles)
                {
                    string fileName = Path.GetFileName(file);
                    if (Regex.IsMatch(fileName, @"backup\d+", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase))
                    {
                        continue;
                    }

                    string destFile = Path.Combine(saveGameBackupDir, fileName);
                    File.Copy(file, destFile, true);
                    backedUpCount++;
                }

                ShowThemedMessage("Backup Complete", "Successfully backed up " + backedUpCount + " character save file(s) to 'ServerMods\\Backup_Saves'.");
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                ShowError("Backing Up Character Saves", ex);
            }
        }

        private void OnManageSavesClicked(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            string charactersLiveDir = Path.Combine(Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.LocalApplicationData), @"MotorTown\Saved\SaveGames\Characters");
            
            if (!Directory.Exists(saveGameBackupDir) || Directory.GetFiles(saveGameBackupDir, "*.sav").Length == 0)
            {
                MessageBox.Show("No saved character backups found in 'ServerMods\\Backup_Saves'. Please run 'Backup Character Saves' first.", "No Saves Backed Up", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Warning);
                return;
            }

            Form manageForm = new Form
            {
                Text = "Manage / Restore Character Saves",
                Width = 480,
                Height = 460,
                StartPosition = FormStartPosition.CenterParent,
                MinimizeBox = false,
                MaximizeBox = false
            };

            Label lblInfo = new Label
            {
                Text = "Select character saves to restore to game\nor delete from backup storage:",
                Location = new Point(15, 15),
                AutoSize = false,
                Size = new Size(435, 40),
                Font = new Font(FontFamily.GenericSansSerif, 9, FontStyle.Bold),
                Anchor = AnchorStyles.Top | AnchorStyles.Left | AnchorStyles.Right
            };

            CheckedListBox chkListSaves = new CheckedListBox
            {
                Location = new Point(15, 60),
                Size = new Size(435, 285),
                CheckOnClick = true,
                Anchor = AnchorStyles.Top | AnchorStyles.Bottom | AnchorStyles.Left | AnchorStyles.Right
            };

            foreach (string file in Directory.GetFiles(saveGameBackupDir, "*.sav"))
            {
                string fileName = Path.GetFileName(file);
                chkListSaves.Items.Add(fileName, true);
            }

            Button btnRestoreSelected = new ShinyButton
            {
                Text = "Restore Selected Saves",
                Location = new Point(15, 355),
                Width = 215,
                Height = 38,
                FlatStyle = FlatStyle.Flat,
                Anchor = AnchorStyles.Bottom | AnchorStyles.Left,
                Font = new Font(FontFamily.GenericSansSerif, 8.5f, FontStyle.Bold)
            };

            Button btnDeleteSelectedSaves = new ShinyButton
            {
                Text = "Delete Selected Saves",
                Location = new Point(238, 355),
                Width = 215,
                Height = 38,
                FlatStyle = FlatStyle.Flat,
                Anchor = AnchorStyles.Bottom | AnchorStyles.Right,
                Font = new Font(FontFamily.GenericSansSerif, 8.5f, FontStyle.Bold)
            };

            btnRestoreSelected.Click += delegate
            {
                if (chkListSaves.CheckedItems.Count == 0)
                {
                    MessageBox.Show("Please check at least one save file to restore.", "Notice");
                    return;
                }

                if (!Directory.Exists(charactersLiveDir))
                {
                    try { Directory.CreateDirectory(charactersLiveDir); }
                    catch (Exception ex)
                    {
                        ShowError("Creating Live Characters Directory", ex);
                        return;
                    }
                }

                if (MessageBox.Show("Are you sure you want to restore the selected character save(s) to your active game files?", "Confirm Restore", MessageBoxButtons.YesNo, MessageBoxIcon.Warning) != DialogResult.Yes)
                    return;

                try
                {
                    int restored = 0;
                    foreach (var item in chkListSaves.CheckedItems)
                    {
                        string fileName = item.ToString();
                        string src = Path.Combine(saveGameBackupDir, fileName);
                        string dest = Path.Combine(charactersLiveDir, fileName);
                        File.Copy(src, dest, true);
                        restored++;
                    }

                    MessageBox.Show("Successfully restored " + restored + " character save file(s) to the game directory.", "Restore Complete", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Information);
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    ShowError("Restoring Character Saves", ex);
                }
            };

            btnDeleteSelectedSaves.Click += delegate
            {
                if (chkListSaves.CheckedItems.Count == 0)
                {
                    MessageBox.Show("Please check at least one save file to delete.", "Notice");
                    return;
                }

                string confirmationInput = Interaction.InputBox("To permanently delete the selected save backup(s), type 'delete' below:", "Confirm Deletion", "");
                if (!confirmationInput.Trim().Equals("delete", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                {
                    MessageBox.Show("Deletion cancelled. You must type 'delete' correctly to confirm.", "Cancelled", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Information);
                    return;
                }

                try
                {
                    int deleted = 0;
                    List<object> itemsToRemove = new List<object>();
                    foreach (var item in chkListSaves.CheckedItems)
                    {
                        string fileName = item.ToString();
                        string targetPath = Path.Combine(saveGameBackupDir, fileName);
                        if (File.Exists(targetPath))
                        {
                            File.Delete(targetPath);
                            deleted++;
                            itemsToRemove.Add(item);
                        }
                    }

                    foreach (var item in itemsToRemove)
                    {
                        chkListSaves.Items.Remove(item);
                    }

                    MessageBox.Show("Successfully deleted " + deleted + " save backup file(s).", "Deleted", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Information);
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    ShowError("Deleting Character Saves", ex);
                }
            };

            manageForm.Controls.Add(lblInfo);
            manageForm.Controls.Add(chkListSaves);
            manageForm.Controls.Add(btnRestoreSelected);
            manageForm.Controls.Add(btnDeleteSelectedSaves);

            ApplyDialogTheme(manageForm);
            manageForm.ShowDialog(this);
        }

        private void OnLaunchGameClicked(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            try
            {
                Process.Start("steam://rungameid/1369670");
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                ShowError("Launch Motor Town via Steam", ex);
            }
        }
    }

    // Custom-drawn button with a glossy, slightly 3D look: a top-to-bottom gradient body,
    // a soft highlight band near the top to fake a glass/shine reflection, a subtle border,
    // and distinct hover/pressed states. FlatStyle is forced to Flat with no built-in border
    // so this OnPaint override is the only thing responsible for drawing the button.
    // Plain Panel is not double-buffered by default, so repeatedly invalidating one for a
    // custom-painted animation (like the busy spinner) visibly flickers. DoubleBuffered is
    // only protected on Control, so it can only be set from inside a class that inherits
    // from it - hence this tiny subclass instead of setting it from the Form.
    public class DoubleBufferedPanel : Panel
    {
        public DoubleBufferedPanel()
        {
            SetStyle(ControlStyles.AllPaintingInWmPaint | ControlStyles.UserPaint | ControlStyles.OptimizedDoubleBuffer, true);
        }
    }

    public class ShinyButton : Button
    {
        private bool isHovering = false;
        private bool isPressed = false;

        public ShinyButton()
        {
            SetStyle(ControlStyles.AllPaintingInWmPaint | ControlStyles.UserPaint | ControlStyles.OptimizedDoubleBuffer | ControlStyles.ResizeRedraw, true);
            FlatStyle = FlatStyle.Flat;
            FlatAppearance.BorderSize = 0;
            Cursor = Cursors.Hand;
        }

        protected override void OnMouseEnter(EventArgs e)
        {
            base.OnMouseEnter(e);
            isHovering = true;
            Invalidate();
        }

        protected override void OnMouseLeave(EventArgs e)
        {
            base.OnMouseLeave(e);
            isHovering = false;
            isPressed = false;
            Invalidate();
        }

        protected override void OnMouseDown(MouseEventArgs mevent)
        {
            base.OnMouseDown(mevent);
            isPressed = true;
            Invalidate();
        }

        protected override void OnMouseUp(MouseEventArgs mevent)
        {
            base.OnMouseUp(mevent);
            isPressed = false;
            Invalidate();
        }

        protected override void OnPaintBackground(PaintEventArgs pevent)
        {
            // Intentionally does nothing: OnPaint below fills the button's entire
            // rectangular bounds itself on every repaint, so there's no separate
            // "background" layer left to paint here. Painting one anyway (even matching
            // colors) risks a visible seam where the two paint passes meet if the button is
            // resized or DPI-scaled between them - the previous corner-color-mismatch bug
            // came from exactly that kind of two-layer approach.
        }

        protected override void OnPaint(PaintEventArgs pevent)
        {
            Graphics g = pevent.Graphics;
            g.SmoothingMode = System.Drawing.Drawing2D.SmoothingMode.None;
            g.PixelOffsetMode = System.Drawing.Drawing2D.PixelOffsetMode.HighSpeed;

            Rectangle bounds = new Rectangle(0, 0, Width, Height);

            Color baseColor = Enabled ? BackColor : Color.FromArgb(90, 90, 90);
            Color topColor = Lighten(baseColor, isPressed ? -6 : (isHovering ? 28 : 16));
            Color bottomColor = Darken(baseColor, isPressed ? 16 : 4);

            // One continuous gradient across the full rectangle - a few extra blend stops
            // give it a soft glossy look without a second overlay shape, which is what
            // previously produced a visible horizontal seam where the overlay's edge met
            // the body fill underneath it.
            using (System.Drawing.Drawing2D.LinearGradientBrush bodyBrush =
                new System.Drawing.Drawing2D.LinearGradientBrush(new Rectangle(0, 0, Math.Max(1, Width), Math.Max(1, Height) + 1), topColor, bottomColor, System.Drawing.Drawing2D.LinearGradientMode.Vertical))
            {
                System.Drawing.Drawing2D.ColorBlend blend = new System.Drawing.Drawing2D.ColorBlend(4);
                blend.Colors = new Color[] { topColor, Lighten(topColor, isPressed ? 0 : 10), baseColor, bottomColor };
                blend.Positions = new float[] { 0f, 0.18f, 0.55f, 1f };
                bodyBrush.InterpolationColors = blend;

                g.FillRectangle(bodyBrush, bounds);
            }

            using (Pen borderPen = new Pen(Darken(baseColor, 45), 1f))
            {
                g.DrawRectangle(borderPen, 0, 0, Width - 1, Height - 1);
            }

            g.SmoothingMode = System.Drawing.Drawing2D.SmoothingMode.AntiAlias;
            g.TextRenderingHint = System.Drawing.Text.TextRenderingHint.ClearTypeGridFit;

            TextRenderer.DrawText(g, Text, Font, bounds, ForeColor,
                TextFormatFlags.HorizontalCenter | TextFormatFlags.VerticalCenter | TextFormatFlags.EndEllipsis);

            if (Focused && ShowFocusCues)
            {
                Rectangle focusRect = Rectangle.Inflate(bounds, -4, -4);
                using (Pen focusPen = new Pen(Color.FromArgb(140, 255, 255, 255)) { DashStyle = System.Drawing.Drawing2D.DashStyle.Dot })
                {
                    g.DrawRectangle(focusPen, focusRect);
                }
            }
        }

        private static Color Lighten(Color c, int amount)
        {
            return Color.FromArgb(c.A, Clamp(c.R + amount), Clamp(c.G + amount), Clamp(c.B + amount));
        }

        private static Color Darken(Color c, int amount)
        {
            return Color.FromArgb(c.A, Clamp(c.R - amount), Clamp(c.G - amount), Clamp(c.B - amount));
        }

        private static int Clamp(int v)
        {
            return v < 0 ? 0 : (v > 255 ? 255 : v);
        }
    }
}

    Write-Host "ModManagerIcon.ico not found next to this script - compiling without a custom icon." -ForegroundColor Yellow
    & $cscPath /target:winexe /out:ModManager.exe /r:System.dll /r:System.Drawing.dll /r:System.Windows.Forms.dll /r:System.IO.Compression.dll /r:System.IO.Compression.FileSystem.dll /r:Microsoft.VisualBasic.dll ModManager.cs
} else {
    & $cscPath /target:winexe /out:ModManager.exe /win32icon:ModManagerIcon.ico /r:System.dll /r:System.Drawing.dll /r:System.Windows.Forms.dll /r:System.IO.Compression.dll /r:System.IO.Compression.FileSystem.dll /r:Microsoft.VisualBasic.dll ModManager.cs
}

if ($?) {
    Write-Host "Compilation successful! Starting ModManager.exe..." -ForegroundColor Green
    Start-Process "ModManager.exe"
